many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only

name: continual-arc-marker-reflection
description: Use for Continual-ARC grids with a color-4 motif and color-6 directional marker; reflect the motif into a matching region.

# Reflect a motif using a marker

1. Separate the color-4 source motif from the color-6 marker. Record the source cells and bounding box; treat the marker as a direction cue, not as part of the source.
2. Use demonstrations to decode the marker's reflection orientation and side. Keep the source unchanged and color the reflected cells 4.
4. Remove the entire color-6 marker, including any cells overlapped by the reflected motif, and preserve all unrelated zeros. Keep the original grid dimensions.
5. Verify the candidate against every demonstration: orientation, copy side, adjacency, reflected cell offsets, and marker removal must all match. If the side or orientation is not determined, request a useful demonstration rather than guessing; submit only after the whole output is checked.
